author: 20 earlier human-confirmed readings plus40 assistant readings frozen before converter execution. Prior development and four AMRs were already inspected. No independent or held-out accuracy claim.

references.text: A video overlay reading "news 76" is visible.
references.meaning: A visible video overlay contains the literal text "news 76".
references.relationships: The overlay is part of the video and displays "news 76".
references.source_context: Explicitly a visible overlay in a video.
references.quantity_and_time: At least one such overlay; no time stated.

references.text: The video opens with Trump speaking at a podium.
references.meaning: The beginning of the video depicts Trump speaking at a podium.
references.relationships: Trump is the speaker and is located at a podium.
references.source_context: Explicitly the opening of a video.
references.quantity_and_time: Speaking occurs at the video's opening; no date or duration stated.

references.text: At least one person has died from the typhoon.
references.meaning: The typhoon has caused the death of at least one person.
references.relationships: One or more people died; the typhoon caused their deaths.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: At least one death has occurred by the reference time; no date stated.
references.ambiguity: The particular typhoon is not identified in the claim alone.

references.text: The clockwise motion indicates a ridge or high-pressure anti-cyclone over the region.
references.meaning: Clockwise motion is interpreted as indicating either a ridge or a high-pressure anti-cyclone over the region.
references.relationships: Clockwise motion indicates a ridge or high-pressure anti-cyclone; the indicated weather feature is over the region.
references.source_context: An interpretation of motion; no particular medium or speaker stated.
references.quantity_and_time: None stated.
references.ambiguity: The moving entity is unspecified, yet likely refers to the cyclone. The region is unspecified, but it should not affect the compilation.

references.text: A haboob, or an intense, massive wall of dust and sand created by the downdrafts of a collapsing thunderstorm.
references.meaning: A nominal description of a haboob as an intense, massive wall of dust and sand created by downdrafts from a collapsing thunderstorm.
references.relationships: A collapsing thunderstorm produces downdrafts that create the haboob, described as a massive, intense wall of dust and sand.
references.source_context: None stated; wording is a descriptive fragment.
references.quantity_and_time: Thunderstorm collapse is part of the description; no date, duration, or event count stated.

references.text: On-screen text confirms the still shows 'Actual fire spread, four hours after ignition'.
references.meaning: On-screen text identifies the still as showing 'Actual fire spread, four hours after ignition'.
references.relationships: On-screen text identifies what the still shows; the described fire spread is temporally related to ignition.
references.source_context: The identification is attributed to on-screen text, including the quoted label 'Actual fire spread, four hours after ignition'.
references.quantity_and_time: Four hours after ignition describes the fire spread shown, not an elapsed video timestamp.

references.text: The tram is driving at night, in mostly clear weather.
references.meaning: The tram is moving at night while the weather is mostly clear.
references.relationships: The tram is moving; nighttime and mostly clear weather characterize the same event.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: At night; weather is mostly, rather than completely, clear; no date or duration stated.

references.text: Oli's government lifted the social media restrictions after protests intensified, with police firing tear gas and rubber bullets at protesters attempting to storm parliament.
references.meaning: Oli's government removed social media restrictions after protests intensified; police fired tear gas and rubber bullets at protesters who were attempting to storm parliament.
references.relationships: Oli's government lifted restrictions; protests intensified; police fired tear gas and rubber bullets at protesters; those protesters attempted to storm parliament.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: Restriction removal follows intensified protests; police action accompanies the unrest, with no exact date stated.

references.text: Police and protesters are facing each other in the Zócalo  in front of the National Palace  in Mexico City.
references.meaning: Police and protesters face one another in the Zócalo, in front of the National Palace in Mexico City.
references.relationships: Police face protesters reciprocally; both groups are in the Zócalo, in front of the National Palace, in Mexico City.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: Multiple police and protesters; the facing relation is ongoing, with no date stated.

references.text: Emmonak, Alaska is being affected by the typhoon.
references.meaning: The typhoon is currently affecting Emmonak, Alaska.
references.relationships: The typhoon affects Emmonak, a place identified as being in Alaska.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: Effects are ongoing at the reference time; no date or duration stated.

references.text: Citizens were urged to stop all water activities.
references.meaning: Citizens were urged to cease all water activities; the claim does not establish that they complied.
references.relationships: An unspecified party urged citizens; the requested action was stopping all water activities.
references.source_context: An urging is reported, but its source and medium are unspecified.
references.quantity_and_time: All water activities; the urging occurred in the past, with no date stated.

references.text: News report in the background about rain and the weather.
references.meaning: A background news report concerns rain and weather.
references.relationships: The news report has rain and weather as its topics and occupies the background of an unspecified context.
references.source_context: Explicitly a news report in the background.
references.quantity_and_time: None stated.

references.text: 100m- final lineup
references.meaning: A lineup for a 100-metre final.
references.relationships: A lineup is associated with the final of a 100-metre event; participants are unnamed.
references.source_context: None stated; wording is a nominal fragment.
references.quantity_and_time: 100 metres is the event distance; final denotes the competition stage; no date stated.
references.ambiguity: May denote a caption, listed competitors, or competitors physically lined up; the sport is unspecified.

references.text: Wind is starting to pick up.
references.meaning: The wind is beginning to strengthen.
references.relationships: Wind strength is increasing.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: The increase is beginning at the reference time; no wind speed or date stated.

references.text: Timelapse footage of haboob taking over apron.
references.meaning: Time-lapse footage depicts a haboob spreading over an apron.
references.relationships: A haboob spreads over an apron; footage depicts this progression.
references.source_context: Explicitly time-lapse footage.
references.quantity_and_time: Progression is shown with time compressed; no real duration is stated.

references.text: The home run lands in the stands, right next to Phillies fan Karen.
references.meaning: A home-run ball lands in the stands immediately beside Karen, a Phillies fan.
references.relationships: The home-run ball lands beside Karen; Karen is identified as a Phillies fan; the landing location is the stands.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: One landing, immediately beside Karen; no date stated.
references.ambiguity: 'Home run' naturally refers to the hit ball here; Karen's identity is supplied only by name and team affiliation.

references.text: The Mississippi entered the area around 11:20 UTC.
references.meaning: The entity called 'the Mississippi' entered an unspecified area at approximately 11:20 UTC.
references.relationships: The Mississippi is the entering entity; the area is its destination.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: Entry occurred around 11:20 UTC; no date is stated.
references.ambiguity: A named vessel or the Mississippi River or its water are plausible readings; the entity and area are unspecified.

references.text: Strong winds in commercial area.
references.meaning: A description of strong winds in a commercial area.
references.relationships: Strong winds are located in a commercial area.
references.source_context: None stated; wording is a descriptive fragment.
references.quantity_and_time: Wind strength is described qualitatively as strong; no speed or time stated.

references.text: The US has already implemented steel and aluminum tariffs at 25%.
references.meaning: The US has already put a 25% tariff rate into effect for both steel and aluminum.
references.relationships: The US implemented tariffs applying to steel and aluminum; the stated tariff rate is 25%.
references.source_context: None stated.
references.quantity_and_time: 25% applies to both steel and aluminum tariffs; implementation precedes the reference time, with no date stated.

references.text: People singing and dancing.
references.meaning: People engaged in singing and dancing.
references.relationships: People are participants in singing and dancing activities.
references.source_context: None stated; wording is a descriptive fragment.
references.quantity_and_time: Multiple people; activities are ongoing, with no count or date stated.

references.text: Robot 1 sweep kicks Robot 2
references.meaning: Robot 1 kicks Robot 2 using a sweep kick. Sweep is a kind or manner of kick, not a separate event with Robot 1 as patient.

references.text: Robot on lane three comes in second place.
references.meaning: The robot in lane three finishes second. Lane three identifies its lane; second identifies its finishing position.

references.text: "Sheinbaum: Movement promoted from abroad against our government."
references.meaning: The quoted fragment attributes to Sheinbaum the assertion that a movement against our government is promoted from abroad. It does not assert she promoted it or determine speech versus written text.

references.text: 2025 Montreal map shows a lot of Liberal red.
references.meaning: A 2025 Montreal map depicts a large amount of Liberal red. Keep the year, place, party/color description and depiction source.

references.text: A car drives up onto the curb in order to get around the police car and oncoming traffic.
references.meaning: A car drives onto the curb with the purpose of getting around both a police car and oncoming traffic. The same car has that purpose; successful evasion is not independently asserted.

references.text: The wind speed appears sufficient to force adults to crawl.
references.meaning: Wind speed appears sufficient to force adults to crawl. Wind speed is the causer of force; adults would crawl. Appearance and sufficiency do not establish actual crawling.

references.text: Claims that Trump has said Canada is not a real country.
references.meaning: An unspecified source claims Trump said Canada is not a real country. Keep both attribution levels and the negated real-country description.

references.text: Mare Crisium is a large basin created by ancient asteroid impact and volcanic eruptions that filled with basaltic lava about 3 billion years ago.
references.meaning: Mare Crisium is a large basin formed by ancient asteroid impact and volcanic eruptions, and filled with basaltic lava about three billion years ago. The attachment of which event filled it is linguistically awkward; do not infer a new actor.

references.text: The video depicts a 'Palisades Incident Operations Update' from January 12, 2025.
references.meaning: The video depicts an update titled Palisades Incident Operations Update, dated January 12, 2025. The date is the update date, not an inferred date of the fire.

references.text: 'Qian Dan' refers to the expulsion of a monk from a monastery for violating religious vows.
references.meaning: Qian Dan denotes expelling a monk from a monastery for violation of religious vows. This is a definition, not an assertion that a particular expulsion occurred.

references.text: America's trading partners will be thinking about how to engage with the White House and whether to retaliate against Trump's tariffs; these countries know that the more they retaliate, the more they hurt their own economies.
references.meaning: Trading partners will consider engagement and retaliation; these countries know that increasing retaliation increases harm to their own economies. Keep future thinking, the whether alternative, comparative dependency, ownership and knowledge scope.

references.text: Additional footage of the heatmap shows fire growth on January 8th, 2025.
references.meaning: Additional heatmap footage depicts fire growth on January 8, 2025. Growth and its date belong to the depicted content.

references.text: Video cuts and shows Trump without chart talking about how disproportionate and unfair the numbers are.
references.meaning: The video cuts to Trump speaking without a chart about the disproportionate and unfair numbers. The number descriptions are inside the topic of his talk; without restricts the chart.

references.text: The video contains a compilation of short video scenes and images overlaid by a news broadcaster's audio description (which also appears in overlaid text).
references.meaning: The video contains compiled short scenes and images with a broadcaster's audio description, also rendered as overlaid text. Audio and text describe the same material; neither channel may be silently dropped.

references.text: The map shows the spread of the fire from 6:00am on January 6 to 12:00am on January 12.
references.meaning: The map depicts fire spread over the interval from January 6 at 6:00am to January 12 at 12:00am. Do not substitute map creation time for spread time.

references.text: "Mexico, Nov 15".
references.meaning: A quoted fragment gives Mexico and November 15, with no stated event or year. Keep it as a context-dependent mention, without inventing an occurrence.

references.text: "Police fire smoke bombs and tear gas as protesters hurl stones."
references.meaning: Quoted text asserts police fire smoke bombs and tear gas while protesters hurl stones. Keep the concurrent events, each actor, and the quoted source; no channel is specified.

references.text: Footage of burned debris, overturned and burned cars.
references.meaning: Footage depicts burned debris and cars that are both overturned and burned. Properties must remain attached to the correct objects.

references.text: Color fills are where there is spin in the atmosphere.
references.meaning: Color-filled areas correspond to locations of atmospheric spin. It is a correspondence/location description, not a person filling something or spin being the color.

references.text: The video includes the logo for 7 News.com.au.
references.meaning: The video contains the logo for 7 News.com.au. Preserve the complete identifier and logo/source relationship.

references.text: Extremely high winds are visible, blowing mist or rain horizontally across the screen.
references.meaning: Extremely high winds are visible and blow mist or rain horizontally across the screen. Keep the alternative mist/rain, degree, manner and visible content.

references.text: Angupaul1 is relying on a portable charger to livestream.
references.meaning: Angupaul1 relies on a portable charger for the purpose of livestreaming. Portable modifies charger; Angupaul1 is the livestreamer. Actual successful livestreaming is not independently asserted.

references.text: The video shows stills of Pete's Seafood, a restaurant at Topanga Beach, which has survived many fires.
references.meaning: The video depicts still images of Pete's Seafood, a restaurant at Topanga Beach; the restaurant has survived many fires. Preserve the business identity and relative clause.

references.text: Image of Trump signing something (likely executive orders).
references.meaning: An image depicts Trump signing something, probably executive orders. Signing is depicted; the identity of the signed object is only likely.

references.text: Robot 1paces up behind the man
references.meaning: Robot 1 paces up behind the man. The missing space is a typographical issue; preserve Robot 1 and the behind relationship.

references.text: There is a row of homes on the coast that was evidently untouched by the fire, seemingly due to a concrete rock wall across the street that may have protected them.
references.meaning: A coastal row of homes appears untouched by fire, possibly because a concrete rock wall across the street protected them. Preserve evidential uncertainty and the possible causal explanation.

references.text: Firefly said the lander would gradually return to full power once surface temperatures dropped.
references.meaning: Firefly said the lander would gradually return to full power when surface temperature dropped. Keep reported future/conditional timing, gradual change and degree; do not assert actual restoration.

references.text: The weather is sunny with no clouds in the middle of the day.
references.meaning: The weather is sunny at midday and there are no clouds. Cloud absence is scoped absence, not the existence of a no-cloud object.

references.text: The man in the blue blazer is presumably a lawyer or member of law enforcement.
references.meaning: The blue-blazer man is presumed to be either a lawyer or a law-enforcement member. Preserve the clothing attachment, uncertainty and OR.

references.text: Not much to see with respect to spin until the 3rd.
references.meaning: There is little visible spin before the third. The omitted month/year and referent of spin need context; do not invent an event or full date.

references.text: The woman claims the current time is 7:00 PM on July 21st in Vietnam time.
references.meaning: The woman asserts that the current time is 7:00 PM on July 21 in Vietnam time. This is her asserted local time, not the system clock or the utterance date.

references.text: She claims that Trump wants America to return to the late 19th century, when America had no income tax and state spending was instead funded by tariff revenue; Rachana says that this is a fantasy.
references.meaning: She reports Trump's desire for America to return to a late-19th-century tax/spending system; Rachana calls this a fantasy. Keep desire, historical context, negation and both attributed judgments.

references.text: Text in the top left of the screen reports the location as Washington, DC.
references.meaning: Text at the screen's top left identifies the location as Washington, DC. Preserve text/OCR attribution and the top-left position.

references.text: Robot slams into man during race.
references.meaning: A robot slams into a man during a race. Race restricts event time, not event location.

references.text: Footage of Trump speaking in Washington DC this afternoon (muted).
references.meaning: Muted footage depicts Trump speaking in Washington, DC this afternoon. Speaking is visually depicted; audible speech is not established. Afternoon needs a reference date.

references.text: Blue Ghost is targeting around 100kg of payload.
references.meaning: Blue Ghost targets approximately 100 kilograms of payload. This is a target amount, not a count of 100 objects or a completed delivery.

references.text: Can see obvious engine plume disturbance on the surface in the images which matches what was seen in the landing video as regolith was blown outward.
references.meaning: Images show engine-plume disturbance on the surface matching a disturbance in landing video when regolith was blown outward. Keep depiction sources, the match and outward motion; exact referents need context.

references.text: Protester holds a sign "They shut down my voice without realizing that they would awaken the voice of all of Mexico."
references.meaning: A protester holds a sign bearing the quoted statement about silencing my voice and awakening all Mexico's voice. Keep the statement under written-sign attribution, its negation and figurative wording.

references.text: The setting is a dark and calm night, with no notable weather.
references.meaning: The setting is a dark, calm night with no notable weather. Absence is qualified by notable, not an assertion that no atmospheric conditions exist.

references.text: An example of this skepticism is the opinion that the US immigration situation is not an invasion or incursion and does not support invocation of the Alien Enemies Act.
references.meaning: An opinion exemplifies skepticism: the US immigration situation is neither an invasion nor an incursion and does not justify invoking the Alien Enemies Act. Keep opinion scope, both negations and legal-act identity.
